native_generation_prompt:
Targeted edit: preserve the good record-to-cases-to-draft-to-review arrows and every exact label. Add dense but meaningful forms to three empty areas: inside Service history, beneath the label add three thick nested record-tab objects with only one large unmarked geometric identifier on each; inside the draft tray add two overlapping blank thick draft sheets and one large unmarked case tab, no lines or strokes; replace the red Owner review pill with an unoccupied, two-level flat review table with a small blocked-outreach stop at the right edge. Print Owner review on that surface, without pill or button shape. Keep the draft arrow anchored to the physical tray and touching the review table. Keep the caveat and all label text inside the current safe bounds. Preserve all other art and connectors.

Create one premium factual textbook editorial mechanism as a single raster PNG. Pure white backdrop, crisp vector-like rendering, subtle editorial depth, an uncluttered hierarchy, and high-contrast forest teal and brick red. Target exact 1200×630. Use an imaginary central 40:21 artwork area if the native canvas is taller, with blank bleed only outside that area. The exported 40:21 area must use its width and height, without letterboxing.

A reusable renewal review draws on permitted service history and returns open cases plus a follow-up draft for owner review.

Open a clean vertical playbook spine on the left above an approved-record inlet. In the center show a stepped dossier with case tabs and citation links as broad geometric tokens, never thin document strokes. At right show a draft tray ending at a closed owner-review boundary. The draft can reach the owner-review port only; no external sending path or schedule icon. Detach the manual-execution caveat.

Use at least twelve meaningful forms with a distinct internal hierarchy. Print only these exact phrases, exactly once each: "Renewal Skill", "Service history", "Open cases", "Follow-up draft", "Owner review", "Run on request". Bold sans serif. Priority typography at least 36px, other labels at least 28px on the 1200×630 export. Keep all labels inside 40px safe margins, outside connectors, and inside the reserved boxes. Do not print instructions, region IDs, positions or metadata.

Only these arrows, with arrowheads attached to actual object ports rather than label text: Service history → Open cases. Identify unresolved cases using the approved records for the requested account. No path to unsupported data or a permission override. Open cases → Follow-up draft. Prepare follow-up using the relevant case evidence. No automatic outreach from the open-case list. Follow-up draft → Owner review. Return the prepared draft to the accountable owner for review. The route ends at owner review and never goes outside the dossier.

No people, humanoids, avatars, shields, gears, knobs, dashboards, logos, invented interfaces or controls, realistic photos, scenery, fake writing, decorative microstrokes, charts, unsupported numbers, success badges, permission changes or alternate implied flows. No scheduling as a current ability in this story, no automatic send, no scope expansion, no claim that every source is permitted.
